% E2E canonical fixture #4 — rules.
% Rule-then-paragraph patterns covering the v6.1 sentinel path
% (\hrule resets _prev_depth to the §679 sentinel so no spurious interline
% glue is inserted before the following paragraph). A \beginsection-style
% idiom (rule above a heading line) plus a mid-body rule pin both the
% rule-first and mid-page arms of PageBuilder.contribute(RuleNode).
\hsize=4in
\vsize=120pt
\nopagenumbers
\hrule
\noindent First paragraph after the leading rule.
\par
\noindent Second paragraph before the mid-body rule.
\par
\hrule
\noindent Third paragraph after the mid-body rule.
\par
\bye
